newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Dollar edges back vs mark, steadies vs yen in NZ.
newsitem.headline: Dollar edges back vs mark, steadies vs yen in NZ.

text.p: 2200 GMT - The dollar edged back against the mark in New Zealand morning trade but was expected to push higher after the Socialist Party gained power after French elections. Different factors were affecting dollar/yen but the outlook there was also for further gains. Expected ranges: 1.7250-1.7350 marks and 116.50-95 yen.
